why: The builder brief's commands run. The verifier brief's don't. It writes "Let B=packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js" but then runs `node B clean1.jsonl bad.jsonl ...`, `node B -` and `node B` using the bare name B, not `$B`. As written, node would look for a file named B, and none exists in the repository. The brief also says "Run every command from the repository root" but puts clean1.jsonl, clean2.jsonl and bad.jsonl "in a temp dir". From the root, those relative paths would not resolve, so Checks 1–3 would fail for reasons unrelated to the PR. Other commands are fine: npm ci, npm test, npm test -w packages/jsonl-lint, git diff against the merge base, and gh pr view/checks with the <pr> placeholder.
